title: UK Gambling Commission Licence Register (Operators, Premises) — filters

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Current records (default), or only the records added, removed or changed since a date — schedule a daily run in changes mode to monitor the register and pay only for what changed.

since.title: Changes since
since.description: Changes mode only: YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the last 7 days. The feed keeps 90 days.

change.title: Change type
change.description: Changes mode only: one kind of change. Default: all three.

record_type.title: Record type
record_type.description: licence = one row per operating licence; domain = website domains registered against operators; premises = licensed premises (shops, casinos, bingo halls, arcades). Leave blank for all.

operator_name.title: Operator name contains
operator_name.description: Licence account name, e.g. a bookmaker, casino group or lottery society (case-insensitive substring).

is_active.title: Active only
is_active.description: Tick for active licences and domains only; untick to include surrendered, revoked, lapsed and inactive rows.

status.title: Status contains
status.description: Active, Surrendered, Revoked, Lapsed, … as published.

activities.title: Activity contains
activities.description: e.g. General Betting, Casino, Bingo, Gaming Machine, Lottery, Gambling Software; for premises: Betting, Casino, Bingo, Adult Gaming Centre, Family Entertainment Centre.

trading_names.title: Trading name contains
trading_names.description: Matches the operator's active trading names on licence rows.

domain_name.title: Domain name contains
domain_name.description: Is this website licensed? e.g. example.com (domain rows).

local_authority.title: Licensing authority contains
local_authority.description: The council, e.g. Leeds City Council (premises rows).

end_date_after.title: Licence ended on or after
end_date_after.description: YYYY-MM-DD — recent surrenders, revocations and lapses

max_results.title: Maximum results
max_results.description: Stop after this many records (you are charged per result).
